card.name: And between drugs in combination products
card.fires_on: The word "and" (sometimes "or") right after the first drug name in a combination product name, such as sitagliptin and metformin. It also fires inside brand names of combination products.

modes.label: And joining two drug names
modes.description: "and" sits between the two generic ingredient names of a combination tablet.
modes.example: Before initiating sitagliptin<< and>> metformin hydrochloride extended-release

modes.label: Or after a combination brand name
modes.description: "or" links a combination brand name to its extended-release version.
modes.example: Warn patients against excessive alcohol intake while receiving INVOKAMET<< or>> INVOKAMET XR.

card.plain: It marks the joining word inside the name of a two-drug combination product, such as sitagliptin and metformin.
